title: Step 4a — Relocation building blocks: readiness, drain receipt, promotion with quarantine; never a context-only takeover
goal: The relocation primitives refuse every unsafe promotion; relocation is not usable end to end until F-016-T16 to F-016-T19.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: checkRelocationReadiness promotes only when the owner-signed main record names this base at a later epoch than a verified standby (or an owner-approved cold restore bound to the standby epoch); empty stores, copied context and active copies are refused as context_only (tests)

The previous epoch is the epoch that actually last ran (the standby epoch, matched by the drain receipt or snapshot), so a re-targeted relocation (B at E+1 never promoted, C at E+2) still promotes (test)

drainCoordinator fences the old main inside one write transaction and returns a base-signed receipt that names the new main base and epoch; promotion refuses a receipt for another base or epoch (tests)
An unplanned move always needs the old host confirmed down or a root-signed revoke; the 65 s/300 s wait alone never suffices (interim until F-016-T16) (test)

Attempted-but-unreconciled outbox rows are quarantined, the inherited lease is cleared and a sole coordinator arms its lease inside the activation transaction, so a crash after it never leaves an active base with lease 0 (tests)

nerv kaji relocate signs the main record (and an optional revoke); nerv kaji drain signs the receipt. Not usable yet: no command runs the promotion (F-016-T17), coordinator lease renewal is not running (F-016-T16), no epoch push (F-016-T18), no Telegram hand-over (F-016-T19)
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.25 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio. 2026-11-23: review fixes on PR #677 (re-targeting, receipt binding, lease in the activation commit, drain re-read, unplanned confirmation) added about 1 h; actual stated. 2026-11-25: closed in the reconciliation: PR #677 merged on green CI (run 45316374919) after its design reviews; no coordinator test failed in a CI run since (reruns were worker-link, B-066). Live proof is the two-device acceptance, F-016-T09.
